delivery.ciSource: 本轮独立最终验证结果未确认。
delivery.qaSummary: 搭建未完成，当前状态 failed。 最近验收记录（不代表完整交付通过）：以真实浏览器+4个角色(员工/服务台/工程师/超管)跑通报修到关闭闭环：员工提交(问题/紧急度/截图)、服务台分派、工程师记录过程与解决办法、员工确认关闭；另一单退回返工后再次解决并关闭。员工仅见本人、工程师仅见被分派(直连他单404)、服务台见全部；创建/分派/解决/退回/确认均产生站内通知且可跳转工单；首页展示待分派、超时与工程师工作量。仅“超过24小时未解决提醒服务台”无法验证：实例无示例数据、无回填时间入口、提醒仅按小时定时器运行且无HTTP触发，属环境/测试准备阻塞。录像工具在 stop 时死锁，改用截图验收。

attention.detail: C01 的“超过24小时未解决时提醒服务台”未验证：交付实例未注入示例数据(库中0工单，sample-data.ts 的预置超时工单未执行)，POST /api/tickets 强制 submittedAt=now 且忽略该字段，无任何 UI/API 可回填或修改工单时间，runOverdueReminders 仅由提供者启动时及每60分钟定时执行、无 HTTP 触发入口；无法在浏览器中合法制造超过24小时的未解决工单。属环境/测试准备阻塞，非业务代码缺陷。

checks.title:
我是IT服务台负责人，需要一个公司内部报修系统。员工提交问题、紧急程度和截图，服务台分派给工程师，工程师记录处理过程和解决办法，员工确认解决后关闭；仍未解决可以退回继续处理。

员工只看自己的工单，工程师只处理分派给自己的工单，服务台查看全部。新分派和处理结果及时通知相关人员，点击通知可以进入对应工单；超过24小时未解决时提醒服务台。首页展示待分派、超时工单和各工程师的工作量。

员工只看自己的工单，工程师只处理分派给自己的工单，服务台查看全部。新分派和处理结果及时通知相关人员，点击通知可以进入对应工单；超过24小时未解决时提醒服务台。首页展示待分派、超时工单和各工程师的工作量。
actions: 以 Super Admin/服务台账号(dispatcher@example.com)确认首页：角色=Service desk，待分派 3、超时 0，工程师工作量表列出 Bob Engineer。

以员工 Alice(employee@example.com) 通过 /main/tickets/new 表单真实提交工单 1“Laptop will not start”(紧急程度 High，上传 sample.png 截图，POST /api/tickets 201、/api/ticketAttachments/uploadMany 201)，提交前截图为 c01-employee-new-ticket.png。
以 Alice 再提交工单 2“VPN disconnects every 10 minutes”(medium) 与工单 3“Email account locked out”(urgent，保持未分派)。
以服务台 Carol(dispatcher@example.com) 提交工单 4“Printer on floor 3 out of toner”，作为非 Alice 请求人的隔离样本。
服务台在工单 1 详情页用“Assign to an engineer”选择 Bob Engineer 并点击 Assign(POST /api/tickets/1/assign 200)，工单状态 Pending→Processing，工程师=Bob Engineer。
服务台同样将工单 2 分派给 Bob（POST /api/tickets/2/assign 200）。
服务台打开 /main/inbox 看到 4 条“New service ticket”通知；点击其中“Laptop will not start”通知的标题链接，地址跳转到 /main/tickets/1，证明点击通知可进入对应工单。
以工程师 Bob(engineer@example.com) 登录并完整重新加载：仪表盘角色=Engineer、工程师工作量 2 active/0 resolved；工单列表仅出现被分派的工单 1、2。
Bob 的 /main/inbox 收到两条“Ticket assigned to you”通知（工单 1、2）。
Bob 在工单 1 记录处理过程“Confirmed the mainboard power rail was dead...”，调用 POST /api/tickets/1/process 200；再填写解决办法并 Resolve(POST /api/tickets/1/resolve 200)，状态→Resolved，历史记录出现 progress 与 resolve 两条。
Bob 直接打开 /main/tickets/3 与 /main/tickets/4：页面显示“This ticket could not be loaded.”，且 GET /api/tickets/3、/api/tickets/4 均返回 404 TICKET_NOT_FOUND，证明工程师看不到未分派/非本人请求的工单。
以 Alice 登录：工单列表仅显示自己的 3 条工单(1 Laptop=Resolved、2 VPN=Processing、3 Email=Pending)，查看不到服务台提交的工单 4（GET /api/tickets/4 → 404）。
Alice 的 /main/inbox 收到“Your ticket has been resolved”通知；点击通知标题链接跳转到 /main/tickets/1。
Alice 在工单 1 点击“Confirm and close”(POST /api/tickets/1/confirm 200)，状态→Closed，历史出现 confirm“Resolution confirmed.”。
退回返工流程：Bob 对工单 2 记录处理过程并 Resolve(200)；Alice 打开工单 2 在“Still not fixed”填入退回原因并点击“Return for more work”(POST /api/tickets/2/return 200)，状态 Resolved→Processing，历史出现 returned。
Bob 的 /main/inbox 收到“Ticket returned for more work”以及工单 1 的“Ticket confirmed and closed”通知。

Bob 对工单 2 再次记录处理过程并 Resolve(200)，状态→Resolved；Alice 再次收到解决通知并“Confirm and close”(POST /api/tickets/2/confirm 200)，状态→Closed；工单 2 历史完整呈现 submitted→assigned→progress→resolved→returned→progress→resolved→confirmed 八条。
服务台复核首页：待分派 2（工单 4 Printer、工单 3 Email），超时 0，工作量表 Bob Engineer 0 active/0 resolved（两单已关闭）；/main/tickets 可见全部 4 单(2 Closed、2 Pending)。

尝试合法触发超时提醒：探测 /api/serviceTickets:list|get|update、/api/itsm:serviceTickets、/api/sampleData:run、/api/app:runSampleData、/api/notifications:list、/api/tickets/overdue|runOverdueReminders|remind 等均 404/400，无回填 submittedAt 或手动触发提醒的浏览器入口。
evidence: 员工提交：c01-employee-new-ticket.png 显示已填 Summary/描述、Urgency=High、已附加 sample.png 且未提交前的表单。
员工可见范围：c01-employee-ticket-list.png 与 c01-employee-sees-own-only.png 仅列出 Alice 的 3 条工单；对工单 4 的 GET 返回 404。
服务台全量：c01-service-desk-all-tickets.png 列出全部 4 条工单（含 Alice 与服务台的），证明服务台查看全部；c01-service-desk-dashboard-before.png 显示待分派 3。
分派：c01-service-desk-assign-ticket.png 显示工单 1 状态 Processing、Engineer=Bob Engineer、Assign 控件。
服务台通知：c01-service-desk-inbox.png 显示 4 条“New service ticket”通知；点击后 跳转 /main/tickets/1。
工程师范围：c01-engineer-ticket-list.png 仅工单 1、2；c01-engineer-isolation-denied.png / c01-engineer-isolation-ticket4-denied.png 显示工单 3/4 加载失败，API 404。
工程师通知：c01-engineer-assignment-inbox.png 显示“Ticket assigned to you”；c01-engineer-notifications.png 含返回返工与确认关闭通知。
工程师处理：c01-engineer-resolve-ticket.png 显示工单 1 Resolved 及处理过程/解决办法与历史。
员工确认：c01-employee-resolve-inbox.png 显示“Your ticket has been resolved”；c01-employee-confirm-view.png 显示 Confirm and close 与“Still not fixed”入口；c01-employee-ticket-closed.png 显示 Closed。
退回返工：c01-employee-return-rework.png 显示退回原因与 Processing；c01-ticket2-closed-after-rework.png 显示返工后 Closed。
首页/工作量：c01-service-desk-dashboard-final.png 显示 Service desk 角色、待分派 2、超时 0、Bob Engineer 工作量；c01-engineer-dashboard.png 显示 Engineer 角色与 2 active。
超时未验证：无任何证据可产生超过 24 小时的未解决工单；首页仅显示 Overdue 0。
checks.result: 环境受阻：除“超过24小时未解决时提醒服务台”外，其余全部子项已在真实浏览器中实际跑通并留证（见 actions/evidence/screenshots）。该超时提醒子项无法在本环境合法触发：1) 交付实例未注入示例数据（sampleData=是，但运行库中仅 Super Admin、0 工单；server/itsm/sample-data.ts 中预置的超时工单从未执行，migrations/seeds.autoRun=false 且示例数据仅在安装期运行，无法经路由触发）；2) POST /api/tickets 由服务端强制 submittedAt=now（zod 只取白名单字段，请求体传入的 submittedAt 被忽略），UI 与自定义路由均无改时间/回填历史的能力；3) 通用 NocoBase 记录 API /api/serviceTickets[:action] 全部 404；4) runOverdueReminders 仅由提供者定时器在启动时及每 60 分钟执行（OVERDUE_INTERVAL_MS=1h），没有任何 HTTP 路由可触发，也无法等待 24 小时。因此超时提醒的正向行为（通知服务台、点击进入工单）无法观测；该失败为测试准备/环境阻塞（缺示例数据+不可改时间），不代表业务代码缺陷。已在浏览器内核对可观测部分：首页正确显示“Overdue 0”计数卡及其说明，/api/tickets/dashboard 的 overdue 为空，对当前未超时工单无误报。

rawRetro.summary: Second repair round. The IT service desk feature that the previous round left unwired is now complete and verified end to end against a running application: migration, role-scoped server service, authenticated /api routes, screenshot upload/download, in-app notifications with ticket route targets, the 24h service-desk reminder, six client pages behind declared routes and navigation, both locales, and logic tests. Four runtime defects were found and fixed during this round: sample data never registered (provider register/boot ordering), the ticket router doubled its prefix, a datetime field was filtered with the string builder, and a wildcard auth middleware leaked from the merged router into every later /api contribution. Full UI workflow browser acceptance was not performed; see the open blocker.

blockers.title: Ticket write-field lists fail ESLint with a redundant type intersection
blockers.symptom: server/itsm/resources.ts lines 58, 66, 77 and 91 reported @typescript-eslint/no-redundant-type-constituents: `string` is overridden by the ServiceTicketRow key union in the intersection type `keyof ServiceTicketRow & string`.
blockers.rootCause: ServiceTicketRow declares only string-named fields, so `keyof ServiceTicketRow` is already a subset of string. Intersecting it with `string` collapses and the rule reports the redundant `string` constituent.
blockers.resolution: Changed the four `satisfies readonly (keyof ServiceTicketRow & string)[]` clauses to `satisfies readonly (keyof ServiceTicketRow)[]`, which still validates every listed write field against the row interface. Repo-wide `eslint . --max-warnings 0` passes.

blockers.title: server/itsm declarations did not type-check
blockers.symptom: tsconfig.server.json reported TS2322 at server/itsm/record-access.ts:74 (rows.map((row) => row.id) returned unknown[] instead of number[]) and TS2314 at server/itsm/resources.ts:237 (CompositeResourceReference requires one type argument).
blockers.rootCause: The Kysely query result row is untyped, so `id` is `unknown`; and the authorization package now makes CompositeResourceReference generic over CompositeResourceActions.
blockers.resolution: Typed the selected id in the map callback (`row.id as number`) and declared the return type as `CompositeResourceReference<CompositeResourceActions>` with the type imported from @nocobase/authorization/core. `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit` passes.

blockers.title: IT service desk feature was not wired or complete
blockers.symptom: The working tree contained only database/main/migrations/202611150001_create_service_tickets.ts and server/itsm/{resources,record-access}.ts. Nothing called registerItsmResources or registerItsmRecordAccess; there were no server routes, no 24h reminder, no notification integration, no client routes/pages/dashboard, no locales, no seeds and no tests. The QA stage confirmed the delivered client bundle had no business keywords and /main/tickets redirected to /main.
blockers.rootCause: The implementation agent stopped after a context overflow at the schema/authorization-declaration stage, so the feature was never composed into the application.
blockers.resolution: Built and wired the whole module: server/itsm/{service,permission-sets,record-access,resources,sample-data}.ts, server/providers/itsm.ts (registered in server/providers/index.ts), server/routes/{schemas,tickets,files,index}.ts, the inbox notification channel, database/main/migrations/202611150001_create_service_tickets.ts, client/hooks/itsm.ts, client/components/itsm/status-badge.tsx, client/pages/{dashboard,tickets,team}, client/routes.ts with a service-desk navigation group, both locales, and tests. The redundant default landing page (client/pages/home) was removed so the dashboard owns `/`. The built client bundle now contains `service-desk`, `ticket/:ticketId`, and the tickets/team/dashboard route ids and locale keys.

blockers.title: Sample data silently never registered
blockers.symptom: Signing in as the sample users employee/dispatcher/engineer returned 401 INVALID_USERNAME_OR_PASSWORD even with APP_SAMPLE_DATA=true, so no demo tickets or role users existed.
blockers.rootCause: registerItsmSampleData ran in ItsmProvider.register() and used app.container.resolveIfCreated(sampleDataToken). The sample-data service is registered by the database provider, whose register() can run after an application provider's, so the token did not exist yet and the call returned undefined without recording anything.
blockers.resolution: Moved registerItsmSampleData into ItsmProvider.boot(). All providers have registered by boot and the application runs the registered samples after every provider is ready, so the sample is both registered in time and still executes with the full container. Verified with `pnpm nocobase db sample` (lists itsm/service-desk) and by signing in as all three role users and reading their scoped ticket lists.

blockers.title: Ticket API routes answered under a doubled prefix
blockers.symptom: The documented GET /api/tickets returned 404 while GET /api/tickets/tickets answered the list; Swagger showed /api/tickets/tickets.
blockers.rootCause: The contribution's createRouter mounted an inner router that already declared `/tickets` at `router.route('/tickets', routes)`. defineApiRoutes contributions are themselves mounted at `/api`, so the segment appeared twice.
blockers.resolution: Changed the mount to `router.route('/', routes)` and added tests/logic/itsm-route-mount.test.ts, which requests `/tickets` on the contributed router and asserts 200 with the list payload.

blockers.title: Datetime field filtered with the string builder
blockers.symptom: GET /api/tickets/dashboard and GET /api/tickets/engineers returned 400 with RepositoryError: Filter group "string" does not match Field "disabledAt" of type "datetime".
blockers.rootCause: listEngineers() used f.string('disabledAt').empty() on the datetime column that records a deactivated user.
blockers.resolution: Changed both occurrences to f.date('disabledAt').empty(). Verified the dashboard and engineers endpoints return 200 at runtime.

blockers.title: Wildcard auth middleware leaked into unrelated API contributions
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts failed: GET /api/articles, /api/example and /api/routesExample returned 401 instead of the expected JSON 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND.
blockers.rootCause: The ticket router registered `routes.use('*', auth.required())` and then mounted that inner router at the contribution root. The application merges every API contribution into one `/api` router, and Hono copies a mounted sub-router's middleware into the parent, so the wildcard authenticated every contribution mounted after the tickets.
blockers.resolution: Scoped the guard to the paths the contribution owns — `routes.use('/tickets', required)` and `routes.use('/tickets/*', required)`. Added a test that merges the ticket router into a parent and asserts a sibling path stays reachable, so the leak cannot return silently. Verified at runtime: anonymous /api/tickets is 401 while anonymous /api/articles is 404.

blockers.title: Full UI workflow browser acceptance was not performed
blockers.symptom: The full UI workflow calls for a design review and one independent browser acceptance review of the running interface; this repair ran under a reduced budget and no browser was installed for the application under test.
blockers.rootCause: Playwright browsers were not available in the environment and installing them exceeded the repair budget.
blockers.resolution: Not performed. Server behaviour was verified end to end with real HTTP requests (role-scoped lists, the full assign → process → resolve → confirm workflow, the return path, notifications with /tickets/{id} targets, the 24h reminder, screenshot upload/download and anonymous rejection), and the client route tree, locale coverage and pages are covered by logic tests and by the built bundle containing the routes and copy. A browser pass over the rendered pages, the clickable notification target and the overlay navigation remains for a full-budget verification round.

improvements.title: Surface lint and type failures in the same verification round
improvements.detail: The verification run stopped at lint and hid two real TypeScript errors in the same new files. A repair agent that only reads the reported lint failure leaves the next round to rediscover them.
improvements.suggestedChange: Run the type check alongside or before lint and aggregate both results into one failure report, or let lint continue so all static checks report in a single round.

improvements.title: A route contribution should not be able to authenticate another contribution
improvements.detail: Registering `router.use('*', auth.required())` inside an API contribution silently widened the guard to every contribution mounted after it, because the application merges all API contributions into one router and Hono copies mounted middleware into the parent. The failure appeared in an unrelated template test, far from the code that caused it.
improvements.suggestedChange: Have app-server reject or warn at start when an API contribution registers middleware whose resolved path is `*` (or otherwise escapes the paths the contribution also defines), and document that guards belong on the exact owned paths.

improvements.title: A sample-data check must start from a fresh install
improvements.detail: Sample data only runs when the default connection is installed with app.sampleData set, then is recorded as skipped on every later start. A verification that reuses an existing development database therefore reports no sample data without the sample code being at fault, which is exactly how this round's missing users first appeared.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a task declares sample data, have the runtime verification install against a fresh database (or run `nocobase db sample`) before asserting the sample users and records exist.

checks.reason: 除“超过24小时未解决时提醒服务台”外，其余全部子项已在真实浏览器中实际跑通并留证（见 actions/evidence/screenshots）。该超时提醒子项无法在本环境合法触发：1) 交付实例未注入示例数据（sampleData=是，但运行库中仅 Super Admin、0 工单；server/itsm/sample-data.ts 中预置的超时工单从未执行，migrations/seeds.autoRun=false 且示例数据仅在安装期运行，无法经路由触发）；2) POST /api/tickets 由服务端强制 submittedAt=now（zod 只取白名单字段，请求体传入的 submittedAt 被忽略），UI 与自定义路由均无改时间/回填历史的能力；3) 通用 NocoBase 记录 API /api/serviceTickets[:action] 全部 404；4) runOverdueReminders 仅由提供者定时器在启动时及每 60 分钟执行（OVERDUE_INTERVAL_MS=1h），没有任何 HTTP 路由可触发，也无法等待 24 小时。因此超时提醒的正向行为（通知服务台、点击进入工单）无法观测；该失败为测试准备/环境阻塞（缺示例数据+不可改时间），不代表业务代码缺陷。已在浏览器内核对可观测部分：首页正确显示“Overdue 0”计数卡及其说明，/api/tickets/dashboard 的 overdue 为空，对当前未超时工单无误报。

process.scope: 仅本 Run 已归档记录；工厂修复轮次不等于 Agent 开发中全部试错次数。缺少 verify-1 时不能声称任务首轮通过。
